**Do not open security issues publicly.** Please report security vulnerabilities responsibly to [mehedirakib.dev@gmail.com](mailto:mehedirakib.dev@gmail.com) with the subject line "[SECURITY] BD Location Kit - Vulnerability Report".

This ensures the security team can address the issue before it becomes public knowledge.

For more information, see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
